description: Liste des acteurs ouverts is published by ADEME. The table lists active waste-management actors and characteristics from their latest validated survey year. Its stated coverage is France; actor-level records. Further dates and resolution are unknown unless specified by the provider. The provider exposes machine-readable metadata; data files were not downloaded. The inspected public resource is free to access. The licence is Licence Ouverte / Open Licence. The latest validated year can differ between actors. For simulation, it can inform waste-service capacity planning or comparisons of collection and treatment scenarios; this is a reviewer assessment of potential use. Related record model-swolfpy provides a comparison in the same service area; technical compatibility was not tested.
